item.title:
Why is there no buzz for this year's NFL Draft? The QBs.

Besides Mendoza & Simpson, you've got:

- Sid the Sloth (Beck)
- Disappointing seniors (Allar & Nussmeier)
- Obligatory random North Dakota St. QB (Payton)
- QB who should be a WR (Green)
- 3 future UFL QBs (Klubnik, Altmyer, Robertson)
